summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its monthly Hong Kong Exchange return (Chapter 19B) for the month ended October 31, 2026. Share counts are unchanged: 829,269,523 Class A and 110,996,801 Class B ordinary shares outstanding, with authorized capital of USD 200,000 unchanged. The issuer confirms compliance with the 25% minimum public float threshold. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary securities-movement report, so there is no risk-arb angle.
